Gastrodon

Water Ground

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Gastrodon is a Water/Ground-type Sea Slug Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 29.9 kg. It evolves from Shellos. Its highest base stat is HP (111), with a base stat total of 475.
